title: Lynkk vs Granola Comparison: Granola Alternative in 50 Seconds | Lynkk

lines: Granola fills out your notes from the call.
Here's Lynkk versus Granola, in under a minute.
Lynkk keeps the recording with the note.
Every timestamp plays the moment it was said.
Double booked? Lynkk's bot joins your Meet, Zoom or Teams call, straight from your calendar.
On the Mac, Lynkk notices the call and asks if you want to record.
Nothing joins it, and it stops by itself when the call ends.
Action items come with owners and due dates.
Send them to Jira from the note, one issue each. No Zapier.
Lynkk records the call, writes the brief, and hands your tasks to Jira.
